description.from: The Amplify build runs bd replay (about 4 minutes of re-scoring the committed answers; no model inference) and fails the deploy when any studies/ file differs. Author's direction: CI in Amplify is not for evaluations. Amplify builds only: fast specs, bd report --json from the committed studies/, and the Astro build. The replay audit moves to a GitHub Actions workflow (replay.yml) on push and pull request, on Linux, so reproducibility is still checked and visible without blocking the site.
description.to: Replace AWS Amplify Git-connected builds with GitHub Actions CI/CD and manual artifact deployment. Data replay and report generation happen only in a contributor-local preparation workflow; GitHub validates source and site behavior, builds the static artifact, and deploys that exact artifact only after main CI succeeds. Amplify hosts prebuilt artifacts only, with no repository build spec.
